# Third-party code in this folder

These files are copied unmodified from npm packages by `npm run vendor`.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lenis.min.js`, `lenis.css` | Lenis, darkroomengineering/lenis | 1.3.27 | MIT |
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | GSAP, greensock/GSAP | 3.15.0 | GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `vanta.net.min.js` | Vanta.js, tengbao/vanta | 0.5.24 | MIT |
| `three.min.js` | three.js | 0.134.0 (the version Vanta targets) | MIT |

react-bits (DavidHDev/react-bits) is a React library and is not included. Its ideas (split-text reveals, spotlight cards, magnetic buttons, marquee, count-up) were re-implemented in plain JavaScript in `js/ui/motion.js`.
